title: Keto Turkish Pilaf Bowl
description: A low-carb adaptation of Turkish pilaf with a flavorful twist. This dish combines the savory taste of pilaf with the freshness of tomato and the richness of luscious.

ingredients.name: Pilaf
ingredients.notes: low-carb pilaf made from cauliflower or zucchini

ingredients.name: Turkish Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: a blend of paprika, cumin, and coriander

instructions: Rinse the pilaf and cook according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, melt 2 tbsp of butter over medium heat.
Add the diced tomato and cook until tender.
Stir in the Turkish Spice Mix and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pilaf, melted luscious cheese, and tomato mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 15-20 minutes.
